newsitem.title: USA: Soros partnership to amend Geotek loan.
newsitem.headline: Soros partnership to amend Geotek loan.

text.p: Wireless communications company Geotek Communications Inc said Wednesday it had reached an agreement with investors affiliated with the Soros Group to amend the terms of its April 1996, $40 million unsecured credit facility.

The company said the group had agreed to allow it until April 4, 1999 to borrow funds under the $40 million facility and repay the principal amount on the date that is five years from the last of such borrowings.
Interest will be payable semiannually at a rate of eight percent, it said.
Prior to the amendment, the company said it had to borrow funds prior to April 4, 1998 and complete repayment within four years of the last borrowing, at an interest rate of 10 percent.
As part of the amendment, Geotek and the group also agreed to extend until April 2003 the expiration date of the warrants to purchase about 4.2 million shares of the comapny's common stock, it said.
They will reset the exercise price to $6 a share, it said, adding that the stock was originally issued in connection with the April 1996 credit facility.
The April 1996 agreement originally provided that the warrants would expire on April 2001 and be exercisable at $9.50 per share, the company said.
